verdict.rationale: Grok Build documents a headless mode for scripts, bots, and machine-friendly tasks. It offers selectable plain, json, or streaming-json output, an ACP JSON-RPC mode over stdin/stdout, and device-code auth for headless environments. A community commenter independently notes the -p headless mode is for scripts and automations. Missing for 10: documentation of how tool-approval prompts are handled in unattended runs, and hands-on corroboration of headless runs in real pipelines.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the agent non-interactively in scripts for workflow automation

citations.quote: Use headless mode for scripts, bots, or other machine-friendly tasks.
This runs Grok as an ACP agent over JSON-RPC on stdin/stdout.
Use it via an interactive TUI, headlessly in scripts or bots, or through the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) in other apps
